eyebrow.zh: Aha · 机器人 · 模型 API

lead.en: One account for an AI assistant, bots that run on a schedule, and one API key for every model. Pay as you go.
lead.zh: 一个账户：AI 助手、按日程运行的机器人，和一把调用所有模型的 API 密钥。按用量付费。

hint.en: Scroll to travel the Milky Way
hint.zh: 向下滚动，沿银河前往各个产品

label.en: A star chart of the Milky Way drawn in characters, with four constellations along it: Aha, Bots, the Model API and the balance.
label.zh: 一张用字符画成的银河星图，沿银河有四个星座：Aha、机器人、模型 API 和余额。

line.zh: 在你的 Windows 电脑上

title.en: An assistant for chat, papers and code.
title.zh: 对话、论文、代码，一个助手。

lead.en: Use it on the web or in the Windows app, in English or Chinese.
lead.zh: 网页版和 Windows 应用都能用，支持中文和英文。

body.en: Search the web, attach files, make images. A project's chats share its instructions and files.
body.zh: 联网搜索、上传文件、生成图片。同一项目里的对话共享指令和文件。

body.en: Aha edits your paper and marks each change to keep or undo. The PDF sits beside the source; Overleaf projects import.
body.zh: Aha 直接改稿，每处改动都可保留或撤销。PDF 与源码并排，可导入 Overleaf 项目。

body.en: Codes in a folder on your Windows PC. The repository stays on your machine.
body.zh: 在你 Windows 电脑的文件夹里写代码，仓库留在本地。

title.en: Bots that work while you're away.
title.zh: 你不在时，机器人照常做事。

lead.en: Give a bot one job, a schedule and a share of your key. It reports back only when something changed.
lead.zh: 给机器人一项任务、一个日程和一份密钥额度。有变化时才向你汇报。

body.en: Runs on a schedule, or when a page, a feed or a webhook fires.
body.zh: 按日程运行，或在网页、订阅源、Webhook 有动静时运行。

body.en: Asks before risky steps. Answer from any device.
body.zh: 敏感步骤先问你，在任何设备上都能答复。

body.en: Up to eight per account, each with its own budget.
body.zh: 每个账户最多八个，额度各自独立。

label.zh: 在 Aha 中打开机器人

title.zh: 一把密钥，调用所有模型。

lead.en: OpenAI-compatible. Every key reaches every model on your account, and the gateway picks the route.
lead.zh: 兼容 OpenAI 接口。每把密钥都能调用账户里的所有模型，线路由网关选择。

body.en: Set a spending cap on each key.
body.zh: 每把密钥可以单独设消费上限。

body.en: Every request is logged with its tokens and cost.
body.zh: 每次请求都记录 Token 用量和费用。

body.en: No plans or groups to choose.
body.zh: 不用选套餐，也不用选分组。

title.en: One balance. Pay as you go.
title.zh: 一份余额，用多少付多少。

lead.en: Aha, bots and the API draw on one prepaid balance in US dollars, at the same model prices. No subscription, no seat fees.
lead.zh: Aha、机器人和 API 共用一份美元预付余额，模型价格相同。没有订阅费，也没有席位费。

body.en: Top up from $5 by card or Link, or from $15 in USDT or USDC.
body.zh: 银行卡或 Link 5 美元起充，USDT 或 USDC 15 美元起充。

body.en: Chats stay until you delete them. Memory is off until you turn it on.
body.zh: 对话保留到你删除为止。记忆默认关闭，由你开启。

body.en: Your data is never sold or shared with advertisers.
body.zh: 你的数据不出售，也不提供给广告商。

lead.en: Set TOKENSBEAT_API_KEY to your key and TOKENSBEAT_MODEL to a model on your account, then call the endpoint you already know.
lead.zh: 把 TOKENSBEAT_API_KEY 设为你的密钥，TOKENSBEAT_MODEL 设为账户里的一个模型名，就能用熟悉的接口调用。

lead.en: Top up once and spend it on Aha, bots and the API. Each model costs the same wherever you use it.
lead.zh: 充值一次，Aha、机器人和 API 都能用。同一个模型在哪里用都是一个价。

label.zh: 银行卡或 Link 起充

note.en: Any fee for the method you pick shows at checkout, before you pay.
note.zh: 所选支付方式如有手续费，会在付款前显示。

lead.en: Open it in your browser, or create an API key in the console.
lead.zh: 在浏览器里打开 Aha，或在控制台创建 API 密钥。
